subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Should this PR wait until Crabbox v0.38.1+ is published and verified through every supported install channel used by AWS cloud workers?
rationale: The code deliberately requires provider metadata unavailable in the currently published Crabbox release, so release coordination determines whether merging preserves existing operator availability.

options.title: Publish dependency first
options.body: Hold the merge until Crabbox v0.38.1+ is available and an installed binary proves the authoritative inspection contract.

options.title: Accept coordinated downtime
options.body: Merge before publication only if maintainers intentionally accept that AWS cloud workers will fail closed until operators can upgrade Crabbox.

recommendation.title: Publish dependency first
recommendation.body: Hold the merge until Crabbox v0.38.1+ is available and an installed binary proves the authoritative inspection contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The cross-repository design, OpenClaw patch, companion Crabbox contract, and documented landing gate all trace to this owner.
